name: UniMicron Technology Corp.
blurb: UniMicron Technology Corp. manufactures printed circuit boards, IC carriers, and related electronic products. The company offers HDI, ELIC, multi-layer, rigid flex, and flexible PCBs, as well as IC substrates including FCCSP, FCBGA, and CSP. It serves customers in Taiwan, China, Asia, the Americas, and internationally, and is a key player in the electronic components sector.
